$comment: Per-class payload rules for the TRS Sec. 9.2 message classes. The class codes themselves live in the constants register and are generated into typed enums; this file adds the per-class payload bound required by TRS-PROTO-007 and the inner event envelope of AMD-005. Every class listed in the register must appear here exactly once - the loader enforces that, so a new class cannot be added without deciding its payload bound.

unknown_handling.rule: Unknown non-critical optional fields are safely skipped; unknown critical versions or types fail closed (TRS-PROTO-006).

decode_order.note: Bounds are validated BEFORE allocation (TRS-PROTO-007). The decoder reads header_length, rejects a header that disagrees with the version's fixed length, then reads payload_length and rejects it against max_payload_ref for the class - all before any buffer is sized.

compression.rule: Optional and negotiated. A compressed payload declares its decompressed size, which is checked against the class maximum BEFORE decompression, and the decompressor is hard-stopped at that bound.

classes.name: HELLO
classes.note: Capability and version bootstrap. Canonical trust is established here, not in the advertisement (TRS-PROTO-017).

classes.name: INTEREST_RESPONSE
classes.note: Decline and ignore must be indistinguishable on the wire - no rejection signal (SRS-MAT).

classes.name: RELAY_ROUTE
classes.note: CR-005. Post-match and nearby-only: never on the relay allow-list. version | routing_id[16] | capability[32].

classes.name: OBJECT_CHUNK
classes.note: Over BLE the effective bound is the negotiated MTU rule, transport.BLE_CHUNK_PAYLOAD.

classes.name: OBJECT_ACK
classes.note: Bounded bitmap or ranges plus a resume token (TRS-PROTO-011).

classes.name: ERROR
classes.note: Carries a stable machine-readable code from error_codes.schema.json (TRS-PROTO-013).

text_event.$comment: AMD-005 inner canonical event envelope carried by class 0x10 TEXT_MESSAGE. Edits, deletes and reactions are AUTHENTICATED EVENTS OVER THE ORIGINAL MESSAGE - they ride the same ratcheted session, so a relay cannot forge or replay one. A REPLY (CR-009) is a new message whose target names the message it answers; the quoted words are never carried, each device draws them from its own copy.

unknown_kind_handling.rule: An unknown event_kind follows TRS-PROTO-006: skipped when non-critical, fail closed when the frame is marked critical.
